item.title: Attorney General Ellison secures settlement with GS Labs regarding overpriced and delayed COVID-19 tests
item.description:
Publication Date: June 10, 2026

Minnesota co-leads bipartisan 18-state group in settlement that includes $4.87M in restitution and payments to states. Minnesotans to receive more than $442,000 in restitution.
